2.6 Distribution of Suicides According to Age
2.6.1 The Statistics of suicides by age-group revealed that the highest
number of suicides (26,284) was committed by persons belonging to the
age-group of 18-30 years which accounted for 44.9% of the total suicides
reported and the lowest (7,283) was committed by the persons above 50
years of age which accounted for 12.4% of the total suicides in the country.
The total number of suicides committed by the persons between 30 to 50
years of age was 17,358 which was 29.6% of the total suicides in India,
